title: Super-Most-Fantastic-Blues-N-Such-Jam @ Cafe Negril
event_description: Weekly blues jam session led by guitarist John Lisi & Delta Funk. Musicians can bring instruments and vocals to participate in this open jam format.
event_venue_information:
About Cafe Negril

Cafe Negril has been a Frenchmen Street institution long before the street became world-famous. Located in the heart of New Orleans' live music district, this venue showcases authentic New Orleans music ranging from reggae to blues, funk to jazz.

Music Programming

The venue features nightly live music with multiple showtimes throughout the evening. Regular performers include Higher Heights Reggae, John Lisi & Delta Funk, Jamey St. Pierre & THC, Jason Neville Funky Soul Band, Bon Bon Vivant, and many more local favorites.

The Tuesday Blues Jam

The Super-Most-Fantastic-Blues-N-Such-Jam happens every Tuesday with multiple sets starting at 7:00 PM. Musicians are encouraged to bring instruments and join in. The jam is led by guitar legend John Lisi and the Delta Funk band, providing solid backing for jammers.

Venue Details

Ground floor high-top tables and stools provide close-to-the-action seating, while an elevated VIP section offers reserved seating with light-up tables and optimal sightlines. The venue maintains a 21+ age requirement and enforces a two-drink minimum. Table service is available throughout the space.

Wednesday Jam Session

Wednesday nights feature Jam-ilton, where vocals are reimagined on saxophone supported by a funky New Orleans rhythm section. Musicians can jam on stage or dance on the floor - all are welcome.

title: Another Bar Open Mic @ Another Bar
event_description: Weekly open mic for music and poetry. Welcoming atmosphere in eclectic Freret Street dive bar with board games and karaoke nights.
event_venue_information:
About Another Bar

Another Bar is a vibrant and eclectic dive bar on Freret Street that serves as a community hub. Known for its welcoming atmosphere and friendly staff, the venue combines live entertainment with a relaxed neighborhood feel.

Weekly Events

Thursday nights host the weekly open mic for music and poetry starting at 8:00 PM. The venue also features karaoke on Sundays and comedy open mic nights on Tuesdays. Board games including skee ball and drunk Jenga are available throughout the week.

Venue Atmosphere

The space features eclectic and artsy decor with picnic-style seating. The bar specializes in affordable mojitos and features Canebrake on tap. The venue attracts an eclectic crowd and provides a perfect setting for a chill night out with friends or a low-key date.

Hours and Details

Open Monday through Thursday 4:00 PM - 12:00 AM, Friday and Saturday 4:00 PM - 2:00 AM, and Sunday 4:00 PM - 12:00 AM. The bar does not allow open tabs - each tab must be closed after every visit.

title: Prytania Bar Open Mic @ Prytania Bar
event_description: Bi-weekly open mic night in Garden District neighborhood bar. Small stage area with basic PA system.
event_venue_information:
About Prytania Bar

Located on the edge of the historic Garden District, The Prytania Bar is a simple, laid-back neighborhood watering hole with ample seating around a 360-degree bar.

Music and Events

The venue hosts live music with a focus on local talent. Every other Friday at 9:00 PM, the bar features an open mic night hosted by Tim Curry. The venue provides a small stage area (not raised) with a 4-channel PA system and two microphones with stands.

Bar Features

The Prytania Bar offers a taste of Southern Regional Craft beers on tap, fun cocktails, spicy Bloody Marys, and their most popular beverage - the Iced Irish Coffee. Trivia nights happen Wednesdays at 7:30 PM.

Daily Specials

Monday: $2 Domestic Beers all day. Tuesday: $2 Well Liquor, Wines & Champagne. Wednesday: Trivia at 7:30pm plus late-night happy hour. Thursday-Friday: Happy Hour 4-8pm with $1 off all draft beer and liquor. Saturday-Sunday: $5 Big Bloody Mary 11am-7pm. During crawfish season (March-May), Fridays feature $10 All You Can Eat Crawfish 5-8pm.

title: Adinkra Lounge Open Mic @ Ashe Cultural Arts Center
event_description: Monthly open mic for all creative expressions. Free and open to the public with welcoming atmosphere for performers of all levels.
event_venue_information:
About Adinkra Lounge / Ashe Cultural Arts Center

Adinkra Lounge is located within the Ashe Cultural Arts Center on Oretha Castle Haley Boulevard in New Orleans. The space provides a platform for creative expression rooted in African American culture and arts.

The Open Mic Night

Monthly open mic nights welcome performers of all levels to share their talents. Whether seasoned performers or first-timers, everyone is invited to take the stage. The event is free and open to the public.

Format and Atmosphere

Doors open at 7:00 PM with the mic opening at 7:30 PM. Performers can sign up on the spot. The atmosphere is supportive and encouraging, focused on building community through shared artistic expression.

About Ashe Cultural Arts Center

Ashe Cultural Arts Center is dedicated to preserving and promoting African and African American culture through the arts. The organization provides space for artists, cultural practitioners, and community members to gather, create, and celebrate.
